## external_construct_validity

<!-- generated from bundle EXP-X03-external-failure-analysis; do not edit -->

| classification | concept | measures_satsa_concept | source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| directly observed | alert workload | yes (volume only) | incident count per final group |
| directly observed | closure behaviour | partly: SAT-SA treats unusually fast closure of security alerts as a possible skipped investigation; in IT service management fast resolution is the service goal | resolved_at - opened_at |
| derived | acknowledgement | approximately | first non-New event time |
| proxy | investigation quality | no: state changes are not investigation steps; ITSM tickets often resolve directly from New | number of Active/Awaiting state events |
| proxy | escalation quality | no: reassignment routes work, it is not a severity escalation | reassignment_count increments |
| proxy | disposition quality | no: outcome semantics unavailable | closed_code (anonymized) |
| unavailable | evidence completeness / monitoring coverage | not evaluable | assets (cmdb_ci known for 54 of 24,918 incidents) |
| derived | peer deviation | only as valid as the underlying proxy metrics | groups of one organisation compared on the metrics above |
| directly observed | external outcome: SLA miss | no: timeliness against a service target, not supervisory execution quality | final made_sla flag |
